summary: Implemented a read-only V4 benchmark reproducer. All independently recomputed hashes, score-grid counts, metrics, coverage values, regime diagnostics, and HOLD reasons match the supplied audit pack; V4 remains shadow_gate_hold.
root_cause: V4 preserves the V3 sample median and changes only dispersion with fixed 0.85/1.10/1.60 scales. Its 21/63-session mean CRPS improvement is 0.991177%, below the frozen 2% Gate, and its Q4 and stress coverage Gates also fail.

changes.change: Added a read-only, independent V4 hash, score, PIT-lineage, event-lineage, regime, Gate, and package reproducer without network or credential access.
Added golden repository integration, incomplete/duplicate score-grid failure, protected-manifest mutation detection, deterministic replay, and secret/network-boundary tests.
Recorded the independently reproduced V4 benchmark, unchanged HOLD decision, pack comparison, safety proof, tests, and unresolved evidence gaps.
Wrote hash-addressed benchmark, package verification, protected before/after, non-mutation, secret-isolation, and test evidence.
Wrote the protocol-compatible task result and test report.

known_limitations: V4 has no explicit terminal-outcome ledger: 72 of 72 receipts lack an outcome row.
All 113615 observations are revision_seq 1, so a real superseding revision chain is not demonstrated.
57973 observations became available after 16:00 ET while the V4 join reduces availability to a date.
The Fed event evidence contains 30 rows but only two independent capture snapshots and six snapshot-meeting identities.
The NFP consensus and actual share the same 2026-08-07T12:30:00Z availability timestamp, so a pre-release snapshot is not proven.

The local broad suite passed 597 tests with one DuckDB/PyArrow test deselected; the declared extras and python-frontmatter were not installed or changed locally, so GitHub CI is the authoritative complete run.
